project.name: MeridianArgus :: Provider :: Anthropic
project.description: Adapter that wraps calls made through the official Anthropic Java SDK (com.anthropic:anthropic-java) Messages API so every call is observed and reported through the MeridianArgus interceptor pipeline. Use this for direct api.anthropic.com access; for Claude models served through AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI, use the meridian-argus-provider-bedrock or meridian-argus-provider-vertex adapters instead so cost is attributed to the hosting platform.
